verdict.rationale: n8n's workflow engine inherently processes arrays of items and community evidence shows real-world use at high volume ("processing millions of workflows each year on a very small server"), implying capacity for bulk-scale automation, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of batch/loop/bulk-item processing features (e.g., Split-in-Batches, item-array iteration) as a distinct capability. Missing for 10: explicit docs on batch-processing nodes or bulk-item iteration, first-party guidance on handling large item sets, and independent confirmation of bulk-operation reliability at scale.
